p0_findings: No canonical lifecycle object/state enum spans intent -> operation -> preview -> approval -> run -> validation -> speaker.
project_generation runtime profile lacks matching completion/result mapping.
Policy/permission vocabularies are not normalized before rendering.
Multiple channel entrypoints can bypass fixes applied to one chat path.
Validation and completion truth can disagree about required outcomes.
p1_findings: Runtime status/degraded can be computed from stale aggregate config/status helpers.
ApprovalRequest stores execution resume details, increasing stale UI risk.
Continue adapter uses a separate regex classifier and policy file.
Artifact lifecycle can be invoked from tool gateway/report writer outside a single runtime route.
Publisher strings show encoding/mojibake risk in user-facing text.
p2_findings: Large router registry makes ownership ambiguous.
Report idempotency exists locally but not through a single report policy service.
Mobile and launcher can format different subsets of approval/task state.

recommended_single_flow.block_b_goal: Create a canonical governance lifecycle facade without deleting legacy immediately.
sequence: Canonical IntentDecision with precedence table and negative constraints.
Single permission resolver output enum: allowed, ask, denied.
Preview builder emits plan_only_preview or executable_task_preview.
ApprovalRequest targets only executable draft or explicit non-execution approval.
TaskRun starts only from approved executable draft.
Completion resolver and validation gate share required outcomes.
Speaker Truth reads only from final lifecycle snapshot.
All channels call the same facade; old routes become adapters.
